title: A prime divisor of a finite kernel produces a nonzero torsion point
statement: Let A be an abelian group, let f:A→A be an additive endomorphism, and equip its kernel with a finite enumeration. Let p be a prime natural number. If p divides the cardinality of ker(f), then there is a∈A such that a≠0, f(a)=0, and p•a=0.
lean_statement: ∀ {A : Type*} [AddCommGroup A] (f : A →+ A) [Fintype f.ker] (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime], p ∣ Fintype.card f.ker → ∃ a : A, a ≠ 0 ∧ f a = 0 ∧ p • a = 0
